governance.decisionForum: King’s Edge Portfolio Board, with referral to relevant Digital and IT product, architecture, data, assurance and service governance where formal authority is required.
governance.decisionScope: Material decisions about the Student Experience Hub product direction, target experience and priority journeys; the September 2027 first-release scope; shared app and platform architecture; the integration mode used for King’s Edge, timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s; any deliberate use of temporary or disposable integrations and the rationale for accepting them; journey and service ownership; sequencing; platform investment and operating costs; integration and data dependencies; launch readiness; rationalisation of existing entry points; and enduring product and service ownership.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC – enduring Student Experience Hub product and service owner
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: The enduring ownership model should be agreed during year one, before the September 2027 production release. It should distinguish accountable Hub product and platform ownership under 4.1.2 from the multidisciplinary team and product practices established through 4.1.3, define ownership of the priority source-system integrations and student-facing content, and establish how cross-service student journeys are governed where no single service controls the whole experience.
